read_format_mode_note: Current widths, bases, quoted STRINGs and dynamic formats follow ../read-formats.md; earlier format exclusions below describe the preceding typed/text adapter boundaries.
text_input_mode_note: Current TextInput parsing, CR and --read-text follow ../text-input.md; earlier CR/text exclusions below describe the 0.63 typed-adapter boundary.
scope: Explicit synchronous typed host input for omitted-file scalar READ; offline execution only

reference_basis.documented: READ lists destinations and optional files/devices, formats and CR; ARRAY data uses subscripts; native error handling depends on input device
reference_basis.uncertainty: Typed values and complete-response validation are chosen Pythonic behavior; native parsing, clearing, buffering, re-prompting and IO_STATUS are not modeled

implementation_choices.destinations: 1..1024 scalar INTEGER/BOOLEAN/REAL/STRING destinations, including narrow aggregate leaves and ordinary variable storage roots
implementation_choices.capture: Capture references once left to right before one callback; later input stores do not change captured indices; preserve nested request order
implementation_choices.callback: Explicit Program(read=...) receives defensive line/type metadata and returns an exact list/tuple of typed values; no implicit stdin or retry
implementation_choices.validation: Check every value before ordered assignments; preserve numeric/storage checks, STRING ASCII/254 input bound then capacity truncation, and SHORT sentinel; repeated scalar aliases use the last value
implementation_choices.failures: No response stores on callback/result rejection; retain earlier effects; propagate interruptions and ordinary cleanup; no rollback of consumed input or earlier stores on a later assignment failure
implementation_choices.observations: Defensive read_requests metadata/outcome copies without response values, reset per run; source-located reads/read_policy; transitive input requests and global/formal writes
implementation_choices.script: Generated scripts containing READ require --read-values with a JSON list of response batches; joint-axis context composes independently

retained_boundaries: No native file/device input, formats, CR, text/binary parsing, buffering, EOF, status/alarm or window-input behavior
No aggregate/temporary/constant destinations, CONFIG subfields, POSITION orientation or active FOR-counter writes
No controller connection or new native acceptance claim; strict remains a future milestone with internal READ rejection
